summary: Interpreted the applied-state receipt and opened the repair-path question. Receipt fa1f90c2eefd45e6af45d7593ac53205 parsed all four events and evaluated the three revised comparisons: after the mesh was reconnected and one further entry was committed, the FSM applied states still disagree (violated at witness index 3) — A and C applied minority-write while B, D and E applied majority-write, with every node's log at index 13 and the surviving leader reporting the current configuration — while the two operand comparisons hold at the same index. That turns the earlier same-term log divergence into permanently divergent applied state, so the child question's experiment-level interpretation is violated/asserted and its question-level account and the parent account were rewritten around the applied consequence, with limits kept for the unexercised repair path, the short healed window, in-memory stores and the missing no-feature restart control. The same-term-divergence fact gained the new receipt as an execution, and a new child question now tracks which permitted mechanism reconciles the divergence — whether installSnapshot, log compaction, a user restore or a term-changing truncation ever replaces the stale node's entry and FSM state — with a discriminator that forces leader snapshot compaction plus one more entry while sampling the divergent index and applied commands on both sides. Incomplete: that experiment and its receipt, the no-feature restart control, and any long-run window over the divergent state.
